entity_raw.definition_raw:
You and your allies have practiced scaling heights together.

Prerequisite(s): Climb 5 ranks.

Benefit(s): When you succeed at a Climb check, allies within 20 feet who also have this feat can climb 5 feet along the same surface as an immediate action. You gain a +5 bonus on Climb checks to catch any falling ally who also has this feat.
